title: Social Security Legislation Amendment (Caring for People on Newstart) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase support for eligible Newstart and Youth Allowance recipients and change indexation arrangements for specified social security pension and allowance payments.
It would provide a $100 fortnightly Newstart supplement for covered recipients and raise specified independent single Youth Allowance rates by the same fortnightly amount.
The substantive changes would begin 28 days after Royal Assent, but payments would depend on Parliament separately making an appropriation to fund the proposed increases.
changes: Newstart supplement eligibility would include illness-separated couples and partnered recipients whose partner is in gaol.
Specified Youth Allowance maximum basic rates would rise by $50 a week.
Listed pensions and allowances would use the highest result from three specified indexation calculations.
summary.affected: Eligible Newstart recipients, independent single Youth Allowance recipients and recipients of the listed pensions and allowances are affected.
